name: softwaretesting
description: Application Requirements 1. Equipment inventory: Create, view, update, delete and search equipment records, including equipment identifiers, descriptions, locations and availability. 2. Equipment booking: Allow authorised users to book equipment, manage bookings and prevent conflicting reservations. 3. Fault reporting: Allow users to report equipment faults and record relevant information about the issue. 4. Maintenance management: Schedule maintenance activities, assign technicians and identify overdue maintenance. 5. Equipment status: Manage equipment status transitions, such as available, booked, under maintenance and out of service. 6. User roles: Support appropriate access permissions for different user types. 7. Reporting: Provide relevant summaries, such as equipment availability, outstanding faults and maintenance activity. 8. Data management: Provide data persistence, validation and appropriate error handling
